source.name: SportsPro: Arsenal's 'UK£70m' extension with Emirates continues England's most enduring stadium naming rights partnership
source.quote: The airline will remain the Premier League champions' front-of-shirt, training kit and stadium naming rights partner until 2033 in a deal that also covers Arsenal's women's and youth teams.

source.name: Arsenal FC – 'Deel and Arsenal announce multi-year sleeve partnership'
source.note: Club-wide sleeve partnership. Arsenal Women wear the same home shirt: the official women's 26/27 home shirt on Arsenal Direct (product WKB9946) shows the Deel logo on the left sleeve, checked visually 2026-09-30.
source.quote: Deel's logo will appear on the left sleeve of our home, away and third shirts from the start of next season

source.name: Arsenal FC – 'The inspiration and features behind our 2026/27 home kit'
source.note: Kit maker. The club's 2026/27 home-kit launch covers both teams; Alessia Russo of Arsenal Women features in the launch.
source.quote: adidas and Arsenal have revealed our new home kit for the 2026/27 season, celebrating 20 years of Emirates Stadium as our home

summary: Dubai's government pays for the front of the Arsenal Women shirt through Emirates, Deel takes the sleeve, and adidas makes the kit.
headline: The shirt is {level}: the front sponsor, Emirates, is owned by the Government of Dubai.
shortLine: Emirates on the front, Deel on the sleeve
